properties.title: Built-up 1985-2023
properties.description: The first year each 30 m cell became built-up, from 1985 to 2023. Colour runs dark purple (built in or before 1985) through green to yellow (built in 2023); anywhere still not built by 2023 is transparent. Two sources are stitched together: 1985-2015 comes from WSF Evolution, which reads Landsat satellite images and measures settled area, and 2017-2023 comes from Google Open Buildings, which measures buildings themselves, counting a cell as built once buildings cover at least 15% of it in two years running. Because the two halves measure slightly different things, compare years within one era rather than across the 2015/16 join. Once a cell is marked built it stays built, so demolition and clearance do not show. There is no 2016 class: built-up that Google sees in 2016 but WSF missed (53.1 sq km, mostly dense low-rise) is dated 2015, which makes the 2015 increment (64.3 sq km) larger than that year's real growth (11.2 sq km).
